dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the open time today?
dialogue.translation: An féidir leat a rá dom an am oscairt inniu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We open at nine, but we close at five.
dialogue.translation: Osclaímid ag naí, ach dúnaimid ag cúig.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And on Saturday, until what time are you open?
dialogue.translation: Agus ar an Satharn, go dtí cén uair a bhíonn tú oscailte?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: On Saturday, we close at one.
dialogue.translation: Ar an Satharn, dúnaimid ag an a haon.

scenario: Choosing a dish from a menu
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun toil a nochtadh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you like to eat?
dialogue.translation: Cad is maith leat ithe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like fish or chicken with rice.
dialogue.translation: Is maith liom iasc nó sicín le ráis.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.
dialogue.translation: Tá an t-iasc an-mhaith anseo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I try some fish, please.
dialogue.translation: Ansín, toinn roinnt iasc, le do thoil.

key_phrases.phrase: What do you like to eat?
The fish is very good here.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Nóid neamhiontrálta i mBéarla: níl aon uimhir ilteanga ag 'money'.
Is féidir é a úsáid mar ainmní ('more money') nó mar bhriathráinm ('more quickly').
Úsáidtear é chun an todhchaí shimplí a chruthú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Caithim airgead anois.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Anseo do chárta. Téigh ansin le do chuid aithenticigh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: An mbeidh tú ag tabhairt tuilleadh airgid dom?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Tá, tabharfaidh mé an airgead duit anois. Téigh ansin.
